subject: Interactive stream degradation — customer notice + mitigation runbook
messages:
From: Eli Zimmerman <eli.zimmerman@clearstream.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Chat sessions stalling — visible since 08:30 PDT

Hi team,

We're seeing a degradation impacting interactive streaming responses across multiple users in our staging org and it's now bleeding into prod sessions. Symptoms: long pauses in partials (clients see spinner for 2–8s between chunks), occasional truncated streams, and elevated 95/99th token latency. It started ~08:30 PDT and affects ~18% of streaming sessions.

Can you confirm if you have an incident? We need immediate mitigations we can apply client-side while you investigate. I'm copying ops for visibility.

Impact: user-visible chat freezes; some sessions time out and reconnect.

Thanks,
Eli
ClearStream — Platform Engineering

[Attachment: client-log-snippet.txt (text/plain)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Zimmerman <eli.zimmerman@clearstream.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Chat sessions stalling — visible since 08:30 PDT

Hi Eli — thank you for the report and logs. We're investigating root cause now. Short-term mitigations you can try immediately while we triage:

1) Switch the affected endpoints to non-streaming mode (append ?stream=false or use the polling Responses endpoint) — this prevents partial-chunk backpressure and should avoid the inter-chunk stalls.
2) If you must keep streaming, reduce client max_chunk_size and set a lower chunk flush threshold (e.g., flush every ~150–256 bytes) to avoid large pauses between token batches.
3) Temporarily route heavy sessions to the lower-latency model variant (recommendation: gptx-compact-v1) — we can programmatically route 100% of your traffic to that variant for the next 2 hours.
4) Add a short client-side reconnection/backoff: on pause >3s, retry with non-streaming for that session.

We've attached an interim trace and are escalating to infra. I'll keep you updated every 30–45 minutes or as we make mitigation changes.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: stream-trace-20270510.txt (text/plain)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: interactive stream degradation — triage tasks

Team — summary of what I saw from ClearStream's logs and our ingress traces:
- Spike in KV-cache evictions correlated with an increase in conversation length and large prompt prefixes.
- Batching queue depth grew; some pods reported slower kernel scheduling after the 2027-05-09 runtime push.

Immediate tasks (short timeline):
- Monica: roll back the scheduler micropatch rolled out 05/09 to the prior kernel on affected pools — target +20 min.
- Karthik: prepare a routing rule to send ClearStream traffic to gptx-compact-v1 and lower batch threshold for that pool.
- Neha: collate per-request traces and kv-cache hit/miss rates for noon PST window; push sample traces to the shared S3 folder.

I'll coordinate communications. Label this P0 and add to incident channel #inc-streaming.

Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Zimmerman <eli.zimmerman@clearstream.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Chat sessions stalling — visible since 08:30 PDT

Eli — quick update on actions we've taken:

• We rolled back the 05/09 scheduler micropatch on the affected shard pool at 10:12 PDT. Initial telemetry shows 95th/99th token latency returning to expected ranges.
• We've provisioned a temporary routing rule so your organization is routed to gptx-compact-v1; this went live at 10:35 PDT.
• We lowered per-pod batching threshold from 12 -> 6 for the next 3 hours to reduce queueing latency.

Client-side mitigations: Rishi's recommendations (switch to non-streaming or smaller chunk flush) are still the fastest path if you want to remove risk immediately.

Can you run a short validation test on your end and let us know if the experience improves? We're monitoring closely and will provide a postmortem within 48 hours.

Monica
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: interim-mitigation-steps.txt (text/plain)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Zimmerman <eli.zimmerman@clearstream.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary — interactive stream degradation (05/10)

Hi Eli — thanks again for the patience and for the quick validation tests. Below is a concise post-incident summary and the actions we took/plan to prevent recurrence.

Timeline (PDT):
- 08:30 — ClearStream reports streaming stalls and elevated tail latency.
- 08:47 — First report received by Redwood.
- 08:55 — Initial mitigation guidance provided to ClearStream (client knobs + routing options).
- 10:12 — Rolled back 05/09 scheduler micropatch on affected pool.
- 10:35 — Traffic routing to gptx-compact-v1 applied for ClearStream.
- 11:00 — Observable reduction in 95/99th token latency; customer validation completed.

Root cause (summary):
A combination of an increased KV-cache working set (longer conversations and larger prefixes) and a recent scheduler micropatch (05/09) created pathological scheduling behavior under certain queue depth patterns. That caused intermittent stalls in the streaming path where batches waited for a delayed kernel turn and resulted in visible pauses between chunks.

What we did (short-term fixes):
- Rolled back the scheduler micropatch that introduced the regression.
- Routed ClearStream to a variant with a smaller memory/kernel footprint (gptx-compact-v1).
- Temporarily lowered batching thresholds to reduce queueing latency.

Planned permanent fixes (medium-term):
- Improve cache eviction heuristics to avoid synchronized evictions during long conversations.
- Strengthen pre-merge tests for scheduler/pacing behavior with synthetic long-conversation workloads.
- Add an automated canary that monitors inter-chunk latency and triggers automatic routing/fallback when thresholds breach.

Customer impact and credit:
We estimate ~18% of your streaming sessions experienced latency visible to end-users during the window above. As a token of goodwill, we'll apply a 10% usage credit for the impacted billing period. I'll coordinate with billing to apply that to your account HS-789123.

Attachments: full RCA PDF with traces and a short runbook for client-side mitigations (attached).

If you'd like, we can run a brief joint validation session to walk through the traces and confirm the long-term mitigations.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
